div.div:
Signed bias is the diagnostic one.
Scatter means imprecision; a
consistent sign means a missing
term. Two mechanisms were found
exactly this way.

div.div:
Nothing here was fitted from the fio corpus: a different source, a different
quantity, a different mechanism. The ceiling is modelled as a serialized lock,
so it does not move when cores are added — which is the observation that
told the paper's authors it was contention rather than CPU cost per request.
